subject: How to find the names of all panels (using getGrob or by other means)?

messages.author: fa023ca25cfe4c63
messages.subject: How to find the names of all panels (using getGrob or by other means)?
parts:
Dear group,
 
I would like to remove a panel from my plot.  My inspiration is from this 'dirty hack' by Kohske; I am trying to do something similar to the original poster.
 
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/7410525/align-ggplot2-axes-using-grid
 
However, I can't locate the name of the panel that I wish to delete.  The following code (going from Kohske's reproducible example, provided in the link above) gives me the name of the first panel, which is "panel-2-2".  But how can I get a listing of all the panels?  grid.ls() produces a lot of output which I am having difficulty sorting through.
 
#p is the name of the plot
>p = g=ggplotGrob(p)
> getGrob(g,"panel",grep=T)
gTree[panel-2-2]
 
Thanks for your help!
Kim

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: How to find the names of all panels (using getGrob or by other means)?
parts:
After plot, try:

library(grid)

sapply(grid.gget("^panel-", grep = TRUE), "[[", "name")

or

showViewport()
